question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

r_tuvrstuvr_tuvrstuvrstuvr_tuvrstuvrst_v
solution:
Given series: r_tuvrstuvr_tuvrstuvrstuvr_tuvrstuvrst_v

Option 1) tust→ r__t__tuvrstuvr__u__tuvrstuvrstuvr__s__tuvrstuvrst__t__v → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) suvt → r__s__tuvrstuvr__u__tuvrstuvrstuvr__v__tuvrstuvrst__t__v → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) sssu → r__**s**__tuvrstuvr__**s**__tuvrstuvrstuvr__**s**__tuvrstuvrst__**u**__v → (It follows the pattern of: rstuv - rstuv - rstuv - rstuv - rstuv - rstuv - rstuv - rstuv)

Option 4) utvu → r__u__tuvrstuvr__t__tuvrstuvrstuvr__v__tuvrstuvrst__u__v → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
